product_family: AI-powered talent intelligence platform for talent acquisition, talent management, HRIT, and onboarding with agentic AI for HR workflows

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Phenom has received its ISO 27001 Certification, which means it has met the standard for protecting and managing employee, company, customer, and partner information.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Cloud security controls standard for 'safer cloud-based environment and reduce the risk of security problems.'

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Protects 'personal data stored in the cloud' and helps providers assess risk for PII protection.

certifications.name: ISO 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: A privacy extension to the ISO/IEC 27001 certifications that requires organizations to establish, implement, maintain, and improve a Privacy Information Management System.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Phenom meets the standards of SOC 2 with report covering 'security and privacy of customer data.'

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: General Data Protection Regulation compliance with standard contractual clauses for international transfers. 'When we do transfer your personal information, we put in place appropriate safeguards (such as standard contractual clauses) in accordance with applicable data protection laws.'

certifications.name: UK Cyber Essentials Plus
certifications.proof_quote: UK government information security assurance scheme held as certification.

certifications.name: CSA (Cloud Security Alliance) Membership
certifications.proof_quote: Phenom is an official member of the Cloud Security Alliance providing guidance on the adoption and secure use of cloud computing.

certifications.name: FSQS-NL
certifications.proof_quote: Mark valued by financial sector purchasers demonstrating organizational commitment to security and compliance.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of current HIPAA certification or BAA offering. Blog mentions healthcare-specific AI tools are 'being developed with built-in HIPAA... capabilities' (future tense), but not currently certified.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification, though AWS infrastructure is PCI Level 1 certified.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: Phenom states it 'aligns with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO 42001' but does not claim certification; alignment is not the same as third-party certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Certification
certifications.proof_quote: Phenom is CSA member but no STAR (Security, Trust & Assurance Registry) certification mentioned in public materials.

privacy.ai_training_note: Phenom explicitly avoids training on demographic or biometric data. Uses 'job-relevant variables' and applies 'science-based practices from industrial organizational psychology, machine learning, and statistics.' Fit Score undergoes annual independent audits confirming fairness with 'no adverse impact or bias detected.' Does not share candidate PII with third parties unless contractually required.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified; company states data may be transferred to countries other than origin; complies with EU-U.S. DPF and UK Extension. Specifics available upon request to sales.

security.name: Data encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS and SSL encryption required for all data in transit

security.name: Data encryption at rest
security.value: Encryption options available for sensitive data at rest; encrypted application database backups (daily on-site, weekly off-site)

security.name: Data destruction
security.value: Data destruction follows DoD 5220.22-M or NIST 800-88 guidelines

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SSH key-based authentication (not passwords); MFA required minimum three times for data center access

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC) model with 24/7 operations center monitoring

security.name: Application security testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing; quarterly DAST/SAST scanning; internal testing

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS secure data centers with firewall security groups, automatic fire detection/suppression, fully redundant electrical power with UPS backup, 24/7 monitoring

security.name: Disaster recovery & business continuity
security.value: Documented processes for recovery of critical business processes, people, and IT systems
